# RUN_ORDER — user-side run sequence for src/synth blocks

Template: LibreLane Classic, sky130A, sky130_fd_sc_hd (copied from
`mac_array` / `attention_core`). Every block dir holds `config.json`,
`run.sh`, `synth.ys.in`, `pnr.tcl`, `pnr_route.tcl`, `merge.tcl`,
`shot.py` plus empty `nl/` + `pnr/` outputs. Generated files say
"GENERATED by gen_layer_configs.sh" — re-run the generator, don't hand-edit.

Regenerate everything (from repo root):

```bash
bash src/synth/gen_layer_configs.sh
```

## Order: small blocks first, layers one at a time

Run ONE block per invocation. Each `layerN_etched` dir is sized for ONE
layer macro only (DIE 2000) — never the full 30-layer model in one run
(OOM kills; keep each block small). Do the small leaves first to shake
out the toolchain, then layers sequentially:

```bash
bash src/synth/mac_array/run.sh          # 480  — smoke test first
bash src/synth/lm_head/run.sh            # 600
bash src/synth/embed_top/run.sh          # 800  (new)
bash src/synth/outproj_tile/run.sh      # 800
bash src/synth/rmsnorm_stage/run.sh     # 800
bash src/synth/attention_core/run.sh    # 1200
bash src/synth/ffn_tile/run.sh          # 1200 (new)
for i in $(seq 0 29); do
  bash src/synth/layer${i}_etched/run.sh  # 2000 each, one at a time
done
```

Each `run.sh` does synth -> place -> route -> GDS merge -> PNG screenshot
and needs the librelane-devshell binaries + the sky130A PDK it points at.

## GDS outputs (per-block, inside its own dir)

| Block dir | GDS | PNG |
|---|---|---|
| `src/synth/mac_array/` | `mac_array.gds` | `mac_array_top.png` |
| `src/synth/lm_head/` | `lm_head.gds` | `lm_head_top.png` |
| `src/synth/embed_top/` | `embed_top.gds` | `embed_top_top.png` |
| `src/synth/outproj_tile/` | `outproj_tile.gds` | `outproj_tile_top.png` |
| `src/synth/rmsnorm_stage/` | `rmsnorm_stage.gds` | `rmsnorm_stage_top.png` |
| `src/synth/attention_core/` | `attention_core.gds` | `attention_core_top.png` |
| `src/synth/ffn_tile/` | `ffn_tile.gds` | `ffn_tile_top.png` |
| `src/synth/layerN_etched/` (N = 0..29) | `layerN_etched.gds` | `layerN_etched_top.png` |

Tile-level assembly ("tiles/") is a later stitching step owned elsewhere;
these per-block GDS files are its inputs, not yet placed into `tiles/`.
